document: Q3 operations report. Revenue 1.2M EUR, up 18 % on Q2. Net revenue retention 104 %. Churn 4.1 %, up from 3.2 %, concentrated in accounts under 50 seats; exit surveys cite slow support. Support backlog 340 tickets, median first response 31 hours (target 8). Two enterprise deals (Acme, Borel) slipped to Q4 on security questionnaires. Proposal: hire two support engineers in October (cost 140k annual) and one security engineer in Q1. Alternative considered: outsource tier-1 support (cost 60k, quality risk).
reader: CEO deciding the Q4 hiring plan this week
